# Discovery of PDE from data (PINN / workflow CEDI)

## Context
Development at CIRAD in the framework of the project Deep2PDE.
Implementation of a complete workflow for the extraction of PDE from data representing space time variations 

## Workflow CEDI
- **C**ollection : synthetic data of woody biomass in 3D
- **E**xtrapolation : spatio-temporal interpolation (surrogate model)
- **D**ifferentiation : computation of the partial derivatives by automatic differentiation
- **I**dentification : estimation of the parameters of the PDE

## Methodes
- Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINN) in 3D
- Complete rewrite of the original code (migration TensorFlow, extension 2D→3D)
- Application to the  dynamics of trees' biomass

## Stack
Python - TensorFlow - GitLab institutionnel (public)
